# apple_subscription_groups (Data Source)

Lists an app's subscription groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_subscription_groups" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `subscription_groups` (Attributes List) The subscription groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--subscription_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the group.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name.
